final: WITH g AS (SELECT college_id, COUNT(*) AS c FROM player_college GROUP BY college_id), s AS (SELECT SUM(c) AS total FROM g WHERE c IS NOT NULL), p AS (SELECT g.c AS c, g.c * 1.0 / s.total AS ratio FROM g JOIN s ON s.total IS NOT NULL), a AS (SELECT AVG(c) AS avg_c FROM p WHERE c IS NOT NULL), k AS (SELECT p.c AS c, p.ratio AS ratio, p.c - a.avg_c AS diff FROM p JOIN a ON a.avg_c IS NOT NULL WHERE p.c > a.avg_c) SELECT AVG(c) AS avg_count, AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio, AVG(diff) AS avg_diff FROM k
